services.name: Business Registration
services.description: Register a new Estonian limited liability company (OÜ). Adult applicants with at least €2500 share capital are auto-approved by DMN; everyone else routes to a civil-servant review queue.

services.name: ROP Driving Learning Permit (Oman)
services.description: Apply for a driving learning license (ROP ITS Demo Scenario 2). Flat 6 OMR fee; eye test fetched from approved opticians; weak vision routes to a Police Hospital assessment; the electronic license with payment receipt is emailed after payment.

services.name: ROP Vehicle Registration (Oman)
services.description: Register a new vehicle with the Royal Oman Police General Traffic Department (ROP ITS Demo Scenario 1). Category-based fee (10–180 OMR) known up front; system condition checks, traffic officer review, fee payment, plate allocation, and certificate by email.

services.name: Vehicle Registration
services.description: Register a vehicle with Transpordiamet (Estonian Transport Authority), with optional co-owner signatures. The vehicle is looked up from a curated catalog; adult sole owners of low-value (under €5k) older (10+ years) vehicles are auto-approved by DMN, everyone else routes to a Transport Authority review.
